_comment: Golden retrieval set for customer memory / Ava (ADR-017, adopting ADR-025). Unlike the handbook's set, `expect` names the note CONTENT a correct answer must find, because a memory has no stable external key; the eval matches on containment through the store's own normaliser. Seed every note in `notes_to_seed` for ONE customer, bind that customer id into the searcher, and score the three modes separately. `kind` is exact (a distinctive token the lexical leg should carry) or paraphrase (no shared vocabulary, where the dense leg should carry); a set with only one kind cannot show what fusion buys. `expect` must appear verbatim inside `notes_to_seed` - the eval test asserts it, because an entry nobody seeds can never be retrieved and would read as a retrieval failure rather than a broken fixture.
